# C06-02 — Resume and change end to end

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-013, ST-014
- Evaluations: EV-010, EV-013
- Inputs: persisted engagement with approvals, jobs, renders and publication annotations
- Output: restarted workflow that preserves valid work and refreshes affected work only
- Dependencies: C06-01, C05-03, C05-04
- Acceptance: no interview or paid job restarts without cause; stale approvals block dependent work
- Verification: terminate/restart and apply representative changes
- Limit: external provider recovery depends on its query support
